tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris Technical Consultant | 5+ Years SAP Commerce Cloud Experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in designing data pipelines, API migrations, performance tuning, CI/CD deployments and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, stakeholder coordination and AI-assisted development across global e-commerce channels.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Hiring Sap Hybris technical consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to join your team as a SAP Hybris Technical Consultant. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that aligns perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: SAP Hybris Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), delivering robust product, catalog and pricing functionality.

bullets.label: API & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and engineered API migrations, while creating PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to synchronize global catalogs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into SAP Commerce solutions and supporting UAT.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps Excellence
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), performed performance tuning of SQL queries and provided 24/7 production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid German residence and work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site.

tailoring.why_company: I admire your company’s focus on delivering resilient e-commerce platforms that integrate seamlessly with complex enterprise ecosystems. Your commitment to innovative, customer-centric solutions matches my passion for building high-performance SAP Commerce Cloud applications that drive business value. Joining your team would allow me to apply my SAP Hybris expertise and techno-functional consulting experience to help you expand and optimize your digital commerce footprint.
tailoring.motivation_short: To leverage my 5+ years of SAP Hybris development and integration experience to drive innovative e-commerce solutions for your company’s growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Hybris specialist with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to your team as a Technical Consultant. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris Technical Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris Technical Consultant role. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.

Best regards
